item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Aug 18
item.description:
8 development commits
## Rust Development Digest - 2026-08-18
### Livestock Improvements
* Set up bull prefabs. * Fixed all animals set to female and added breeding FSM states.
### Nexus Server Features
* Servers with Nexus enabled are now tagged with `nexuszone` (`^x`). * Zone servers are hidden from the server list by default (can be disabled with `nexus.hideZones`). * Nexus info is exposed in A2S rules response when Nexus is enabled. * Fixed the map button not enabling on the connect modal for the Nexus path. * Fixed Nexus map squishing issues.
### Demo UI Enhancements
* Redone the Demo UI sandbox panel, adding parenting and a new color picker. * Added keyframing for light intensity and range.
### Render Pipeline Updates
* Fixed refraction texture for underwater labs windows when using RRP.
### Network & RPC Fixes
* Fixed battery `ReceiveAdditionalData` client RPC.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Aug 17
item.description:
37 development commits
# Rust Daily Development Digest - 2026-08-17
## Game Planner & Building Optimizations
* Server performance improved by culling the bone hierarchy on building and boat planners, removing 17 GameObjects per planner. * Optimized conditional models to refresh only when changed, preventing unnecessary destruction and recreation. * Rooms are now hidden only after being invisible for 5+ seconds to prevent visual glitches during animations and reduce network churn.
## IO System Overhaul & Conversions
* Continued conversion of IO-related prefabs, including CCTV cameras, windmills, water wheels, Tesla coils, and igniters. * Removed old IO code from the battery class. * Simplified battery console commands. * Set main power slots for EngineListener and AlarmSystem prefabs. * Cleaned up TeslaCoil, SolarPanel, and FuelGenerator prefabs.
## UI & Menu Improvements
* Added a scroll fade/gradient to tabs in the demo UI. * Fixed alignment issues on non-keyframable rows in the demo UI. * Ordered F1 menu category buttons alphabetically by their translated label.
## Bug Fixes & Refinements
* Fixed jungle primitive loot box gibs not using the proper material upon destruction. * Fixed gibs for the basic crate and its colliders. * Re-exported the basic crate to zero out its scale. * Fixed an issue where log messages from other threads were not appearing in the console/RCON. * Fixed typo and effects firing issues with the honey bandage. * Fixed the issue of not being able to transfer water into a held water bucket via the UI. * Fixed `MaxPlayers` being incorrect after recent changes to the Nexus system. * Fixed Nexus connect modal issues. * Fixed performance logging NRE and hot reload issues. * Fixed a second client NRE, crosshair NRE, and added custom FP scenario dropdown for multiplayer editor. * Fixed `Unsafe.UseMultithreadedScripting` on the client, with ongoing work for IL2CPP builds.
## Content & Testing
* Added a white boomer firework color variant, including its item, mortar, shell, icon, and PFX. * Added a per-face physics material test asset for collider testing. * RidableHorse.prefab has been updated. * Exported a test list and added test feedback. * Consolidated OS-specific calls to `RustNative` for unsafe scripting access, with Linux and Mac builds and tests pending. * Moved file storage code to avoid unloading it during domain reloads.
